ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Translation Beyond Invisibility: How to Weaken Texts. Translation as a ?weakening? of texts, in the sense that forms of central authority are questioned/jeopardized by translation: spectralized, marginalized, contested, rhizomatic, debased, thus contesting postures and figures of authority, introducing play, uncertainty, remediation. Instructor: Visiting Professor, Antoine Caz¿ from the Universit¿ Denis Diderot, Paris VII. Professor Caz¿ is the Director of the Paris VII Center for Translation Studies and a well-known translator of American literature into French.
